## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or contract outcome and why this is the smallest complete change.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests demonstrate the changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Security, privacy, compatibility, and generated-artifact effects are described or not applicable.
- [ ] Scanner protocol changes update schemas, documentation, fixtures, and bindings together.
- [ ] Every commit includes a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No credentials, private source, customer artifacts, or local absolute paths are included.
